title: When a plan may become the program of record

blocks.text: The school district (invented for this practice) locks one repair program per budget year as its program of record. Each plan is a dict:
`inputs_hash` is the hash of the plan's current inputs, and the run records the hash of the inputs it was solved on.

Write `lock_refusal(plan_id, plans)` in `guard.py`. It returns `None` when the plan may be locked now, and otherwise a short reason (any non-empty string). A plan may be locked only when it is in state `Reviewed`, its run was solved on its current inputs and found an optimal plan, and no other plan of the same year is already `Locked`. About ten lines.

"""Run executes this file. Change the calls and see what prints. Submit grades."""
import logging

# Turn the logger up, so the `log.debug` lines of your code show under the printed lines.
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG, format="%(levelname)s %(message)s")

from guard import lock_refusal

plans = {
    "K-1": {"year": 2031, "state": "Reviewed", "inputs_hash": "f3",
            "run": {"inputs_hash": "f3", "status": "OPTIMAL"}},
    "K-2": {"year": 2031, "state": "Reviewed", "inputs_hash": "c9",
            "run": {"inputs_hash": "c2", "status": "OPTIMAL"}},
    "K-3": {"year": 2032, "state": "Submitted", "inputs_hash": "d4", "run": None},
    "K-4": {"year": 2033, "state": "Reviewed", "inputs_hash": "e5",
            "run": {"inputs_hash": "e5", "status": "FEASIBLE"}},
}
for plan_id in plans:
    print(f"lock {plan_id}:", lock_refusal(plan_id, plans))
plans["K-5"] = {"year": 2031, "state": "Locked", "inputs_hash": "a0", "run": None}
print("lock K-1 with K-5 Locked for 2031:", lock_refusal("K-1", plans))

cases.says: a reviewed plan whose optimal run used its current inputs may lock, and a draft may not
a run made on older inputs, or no run at all, blocks the lock
a current run that found no plan blocks the lock
another locked plan of the same year blocks the lock, one of another year does not

origin.section: Budget Lock Needs a Current Optimal Run, and a Cycle Has One Plan of Record

concepts: locking needs the right state, a current optimal run, and no other locked plan in the cycle
